the failure mode and carrying capability of the hybrid joints depend on the number of bolts and lap length.

the failure modes of hybrid joints are mainly divided into three types, which are bolt pullout, shear failure and bolt bearing failure, and the failure mode of hybrid joints is affected by end distance, the lap length, the number of bolt and diameter of bolts, and the failure modes of the hybrid joint can be changed from bolt pullout to bolt bearing failure with the increase of end distance, the decrease of lap length and the number of bolt, and the decrease of bolt diameter.
